selection_rule: Explicit participant selection only; never inferred from profile or missing evidence.
adjustment_rule: Explicit edits keep the selected preset ID and record actual/normalized weights and weights_adjusted; unknown positive-weight input blocks final score.
comparison_warning: Notas de configurações ou pesos diferentes não devem ser comparadas diretamente.

academic-derived-base-five-v1.label: Base — cinco dimensões
academic-derived-base-five-v1.justification: Project methodological choice: the five active reference weights sum to 75; divide each by 75 and multiply by 100, round half-up to four decimal places, and assign the 0.0001 percentage-point residual to the last active dimension. Fixed vector for every vehicle; not adapted to evidence gaps.

academic-derived-expanded-seven-v1.label: Ampliada — sete dimensões
academic-derived-expanded-seven-v1.justification: Project methodological choice: preserve the seven reference weights exactly; positive unknown dimensions block the final score.
